english: Let's leave him alone...\nMy instincts say it's safer.
Hey! Got any Gin Tama?\nDragon Tama?!\nSpare me one?!
It's not a handcart!\nIt's my HOME!
Um... We'd like to\nrehearse, if that's okay...\f...No use.\nNobody's listening...
I seem to be losing\nfemale fans lately...\fCan't imagine why...
The only change lately?\nA little slipup...\fAnd a shotgun wedding.\nThat's about it.
No, not that...\nHeard any rumors\nabout Gin Tama lately?
Obviously cosplay.\nA real ninja wouldn't\ntell us his name.
We're in the wrong, but\nhe matters to us.\nCan't you let him off?
I wondered what'd happen...\nCall it curiosity?
It's fine, Otae!\nIt's all fine!\nStay in your room!
My, two keepers here,\nand you still let\nyour gorilla roam free?
I'll end you in\na Gin Tama battle!
Fine. For your bravery,\nI'll let it slide...\nIn exchange for your life.
For your effort,\nI'll forgive you this time.\fThere won't be a next time.

You're right, Mama.
That drunk made up the tale
of a rare-orb stranger... We've got a different
kind of strange one here.
Why'd you have to\nset Mama off?!\nJust get out, already!
Hey. You with the stubble.\nAnd you with the chin.
Amazing. He's forgotten\nthe previous event already.

Leave them, Agomi.
They're Shinsengumi. Don't stir them up.
They'll dig for dirt
that isn't there.
WHAT?!\fForget my stubble!\nYou called my\nprecious girl a chin?!
We're not suspicious, miss!\nJust thought you could\nspare a few Gin Tama...

translator_note: Hasegawa encounter or Hijikata Special shop exchange.

english: As ordered! So good...\fI made it a Gin Tama.
Only one prototype. Take it with you!
Mmm... The red beans...\fThey're laughing\nwhile doing the\nIna Bauer...
I tried this place's\nnew dish...\fAn Uji Kintoki rice bowl,\nor something...
Got any Gin Tama...?\nNo, Dragon Tama?!

Gin Tama battles
are pretty deep... I used to win by
brute force, but tough
guys wipe the floor with me. Guess there's a limit
to muscle alone...

Gin Tama battles... How do I put it?
Watch your opponent.
Find their weak point. Then strategy.
Defense, boosts, traps... Aaargh! Damn it all!
Come on, brain! WORK!
Oh, good timing.\nI was looking for you.
Word travels fast, huh?\fThey broke up at noon,\nbut at this hour\nthe customers gather again.
Huh? This...\fDoes my hairline look\nless natural than usual?

Doesn't bother you?
Wasn't that a weird
way to put it? You'd normally say
it doesn't show, right? What do you mean,
it doesn't bother you?
What does that mean?!
Is it just me,\nor am I losing\nsome authority here?

That's the point!
It SHOULD bother you! You're in Bulldog,
Kabukicho's toughest
biker gang, aren't you?! You should care
about your boss!
Us bikers feel right\nat home outside\na convenience store.
Forgotten, Kondo?\fYou know. The old man's\nprecious daughter, Kuriko...
Let's leave it, Kondo.\nCome on, let's go.
Huh? You two split up?\nGood! The old man\ncan relax now.
Stop calling me her ex!\fDamn it... If he hadn't\nshown up, Kuriko and I...
That guy! You know...\nWhat was his name?
Yeah! Mayora 13!\nThis is all his fault!
...Mamushi Z?\nThere's a Gin Tama\nlike that too?
Again? Mom bought you some last birthday!
No!\fI can't buy that!\nI've never even\nseen one myself!
Ugh... How do you even\nknow such a rare orb?\fAll right.\nI'll splurge this once.
Hey, sis!\nBuy me some Gin Tama!

translator_note: Dragon Tama abbreviated as D.T. to fit the original two-glyph slot; full term retained elsewhere.

english: Can't wait! Mamushi Z...\nNext, a character orb.
Well, this is unusual.\nWhat brings\nthe Shinsengumi here?
We buy unwanted things\nand sell them cheaply\nto people who need them.
Sorry...\nWe don't deal\nin Gin Tama here.
You're Shinsengumi.\nYou know the trouble\nthose things bring.
Gin Tama?!\nAny Dragon Tama?!\nPlease say yes!
Give me a break!\nI haven't done\nanything wrong yet...
Huh? Gin Tama?\nUm... If these will do...

translator_note: Earth Defense Force shortened to EDF in this fixed slot; full name appears in the preceding exchange.

english: Depending on your answer,\nI'll haul you all in...
Sougo... Forgot my\nprotractor. Mind if I\ngo home and get it?
By the way,\ngot any Gin Tama?
Oh well. Cheer up, Toshi!\nWe've got more Gin Tama!

No, Hijikata.
Don't judge them
by their looks... These guys reek
of small fry.
Hey, is there\na tofu seller in there?
Your face changed\nat the sight of us.\nYou a Joui rebel...?

translator_note: Sogo is the short romanization of Sougo, used only for this two-glyph address slot.

english: This again?!\nCan't you fight\nyour own battles...?
Got it...\nDon't lose to that guy.
Gin Tama?! You have some?\nAny Dragon Tama?\nGot any?!
You saw a Dragon Tama?!\nWhere, where, WHERE?!
Well?! Where did you\nsee the Dragon Tama?!
No, no! I quit\nthe Joui rebels!\nI'm just unemployed now...
I don't have\na Dragon Tama either...\fBut I just saw one...
Beat me in a\nGin Tama battle\nand I'll tell you. Deal?
Not that much...\nHe ran off the way\nyou came from, though...

I tried to battle
a silver-haired guy
with dead fish eyes... He had too few orbs,
so I turned him down.
He'll be back with more.
The Dragon Tama guy\nran off the way\nyou came from...
Damn... You and\nthat silver-haired guy...\nWhy are you so strong?
...\fSorry. I'm busy\nlooking for someone.\nCan this wait?
Gin! Here of all places!\nIt must be fate!
What?! Who are you?!\nPosing as Gin to approach me?\nI'm not that easy!
Who's Gin?!\nDon't mistake me\nfor THAT bastard!
Yeah. An old friend\nof the old man...\nPut your glasses on!
Suspicious guy...\nWhat are you doing here?
Kondo... After all that,\nwhy do you believe him?
Fine. For Kondo's sake,\nI'll let you off today.
He's got a golf club\nand said practice swings.\nWhat else could it be?
Huh? An Inui?\nWhat are you doing here?
Amanto or not,\nwe can talk, can't we?
The Inui are warriors.\nWhat's one of you\ndoing here?
Idiot! I told you\nnot to mess with the Inui!
I told you!\fThe Inui were the first\nAmanto here! Their greeting\nwas a cannon barrage!
